fnol_text: My name is Naomi Ishikawa and I live at 536 Juniper Road, Greenville, SC 29617. You can reach me on (555) 626-6502 or naomi.ishikawa@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 11 October 2024. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2023-00159. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Ishikawa on (555) 626-6502 to acknowledge the claim. Naomi confirmed the loss date as 11 October 2024.
Site visit to 536 Juniper Road. Neighbour Nikhil Petrov was present and confirmed the timeline.
Naomi sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
